name: xhtoken/spark-x2.6-4b-dspark-gguf
title: DSpark speculative-decoding draft for Spark-X2.6-4B: about 2.1x on an RTX 4090 in llama.cpp and 2.5x on an M5 Pro in MLX
summary: iFlytek's Spark team released a 624M-parameter BF16 draft model that proposes up to 7 tokens at a time for the 4B Spark-X2.6. They report an average 2.14x speedup on an RTX 4090 with llama.cpp, 2.50x on an M5 Pro with MLX and a 2.94x peak on MATH500. GGUFs are on Hugging Face and ModelScope; llama.cpp support runs from their fork while upstreaming is in progress.
